journeys.name: View and Manage Your Certificates
journeys.description: The user enters the service and views their available certificates, with options to contact support or select a certificate to manage.

journeys.name: Download a Shared Framework Certificate PDF
journeys.description: A third party downloads the PDF of a shared framework certificate after accessing the sharing link.

journeys.name: Contact Support
journeys.description: The user starts from the certificates list or a specific certificate and submits a support request.

journeys.name: Authorise and Match to Results
journeys.description: The user enters personal details to try to match their records and, if successful, sees their certificates.

journeys.name: Initiate Print Request for a Certificate
journeys.description: The user selects an address, reviews the delivery request, and confirms the print request for their certificate.

journeys.name: Create and Share a Certificate Digitally
journeys.description: The user creates a sharing link for a certificate, proceeds to share it by email, and receives email confirmation.

journeys.name: Contact Support About a Specific Framework Certificate
journeys.description: The user contacts support regarding a specific framework certificate and submits a help request.
